description: Lists a page of buildings for a Google Workspace customer, including available addresses, coordinates, and floor names. Use the continuation token for further pages; Directory API access and appropriate administrator privileges are required.

customer.description: The unique ID for the customer's Google Workspace account. Use 'my_customer' alias to represent your account's customer ID. As an account administrator, this alias represents your account's customer ID.
customer.title: Customer

maxResults.description: Maximum number of buildings to return per page. Defaults to 25 for optimal performance.
maxResults.title: Max Results

pageToken.description: Token to specify the next page in the list. Obtained from nextPageToken in a previous response. Omit for the first page.
pageToken.title: Page Token

name: list_buildings

Building.description: Represents a building resource in Google Workspace.

address.description: The postal address of the building.
address.title: Address

buildingId.description: Unique identifier for the building. Maximum length is 100 characters.
buildingId.title: Building Id

buildingName.description: The building name as seen by users in Calendar. Must be unique for the customer. Maximum length is 100 characters.
buildingName.title: Building Name

coordinates.description: Geographic center location of the building.
coordinates.title: Coordinates

description.description: A brief description of the building.
description.title: Description

etags.description: ETag of the resource for concurrency control.
etags.title: Etags

floorNames.description: The display names for all floors in this building, sorted in ascending order.
floorNames.title: Floor Names

Building.title: Building

addressLines.description: Unstructured address lines containing street address and additional details.
addressLines.title: Address Lines

administrativeArea.description: Highest administrative subdivision (e.g., state or province).
administrativeArea.title: Administrative Area

languageCode.description: BCP-47 language code of the address (e.g., 'en', 'es').
languageCode.title: Language Code

locality.description: City or town portion of the address.
locality.title: Locality

regionCode.description: CLDR region code of the country/region (e.g., 'US', 'GB').
regionCode.title: Region Code

buildings.description: List of building resources in this page of results. May be empty if no buildings exist.
buildings.title: Buildings

etag.description: ETag of the collection for cache validation.
etag.title: Etag

kind.description: Kind of resource this is, always 'admin#directory#resources#buildings#buildingsList'.
kind.title: Kind

nextPageToken.description: Token used to access the next page of results. Absent when there are no more pages. Pass this value as pageToken in the next request to retrieve the next page.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
